7. CONFIDENTIALITY
Confidential Information includes information of Recipient and its affiliates. Recipient may disclose it when required by law after prompt notice. These duties survive termination or expiration.

8. INDEMNIFICATION
Provider shall indemnify and hold harmless Client from third-party claims, and Provider shall control the defense subject to Client's right to participate.

9. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
The aggregate liability cap does not apply to breach of confidentiality or indemnification obligations.

10. ASSIGNMENT
Neither party may assign this Agreement without prior written consent.

11. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement is governed by the laws of New York.

12. BUSINESS ASSOCIATE
The parties shall execute a business associate agreement before exchanging protected health information.
